items.title: 为破解净值困局，部分“消费”基金转投科技
items.raw_excerpt: 近段时间以来，面对科技主线的持续强势与传统消费的低位震荡，不少以“消费”为标签的主题基金为破解净值困局，开始跨界重仓硬科技赛道。多只消费主题基金凭借“万物皆消费”的理念重仓人工智能（AI）板块，在业绩方面实现了领跑。不过，有基金经理坦言，科技板块的“虹吸效应”极大挤压了消费板块的流动性，对于部分追求净值排名的基金经理而言，博弈科技被视为一种无奈之举。虽然拥抱AI与半导体的调仓动作换来了短期的业绩修复，却也让自己站上了“风格漂移”争议的风口浪尖。（证券时报）

title_i18n.zh: 为破解净值困局，部分“消费”基金转投科技
title_i18n.en: To break the net value deadlock, some "consumer" funds have shifted to technology investments.
title_i18n.es: Para resolver el dilema del valor neto, algunos fondos de "consumo" se han desviado hacia la tecnología.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 近段时间以来，面对科技主线的持续强势与传统消费的低位震荡，不少以“消费”为标签的主题基金为破解净值困局，开始跨界重仓硬科技赛道。多只消费主题基金凭借“万物皆消费”的理念重仓人工智能（AI）板块，在业绩方面实现了领跑。不过，有基金经理坦言，科技板块的“虹吸效应”极大挤压了消费板块的流动性，对于部分追求净值排名的基金经理而言，博弈科技被视为一种无奈之举。虽然拥抱AI与半导体的调仓动作换来了短期的业绩修复，却也让自己站上了“风格漂移”争议的风口浪尖。（证券时报）
excerpt_i18n.en: Recently, as the tech sector continues to strengthen while traditional consumer stocks remain in a low-level consolidation, many theme funds labeled as "consumer" have begun to cross over and heavily invest in the hard-tech track to break free from net value difficulties. Several consumer-themed funds, leveraging the concept of "everything is consumption," have heavily invested in the AI sector, achieving leading performance. However, some fund managers admit that the "siphoning effect" of the tech sector has significantly squeezed liquidity in the consumer sector. For some fund managers focused on net value rankings, betting on tech is seen as a last resort. While the shift toward AI and semiconductors has brought short-term performance recovery, it has also placed them at the center of controversy over "style drift." (Securities Times)
excerpt_i18n.es: Últimamente, ante la persistente fortaleza de la línea principal tecnológica y la volatilidad a la baja del consumo tradicional, muchos fondos temáticos etiquetados como "consumo" han comenzado a realizar apuestas transfronterizas en el sector de tecnología dura para resolver el estancamiento del valor neto. Varios fondos temáticos de consumo, basándose en la filosofía de "todo es consumo", han apostado fuertemente por el sector de inteligencia artificial (IA), logrando un rendimiento líder. Sin embargo, algunos gestores de fondos admiten que el "efecto de succión" del sector tecnológico ha reducido significativamente la liquidez del sector de consumo. Para aquellos gestores que buscan mejorar el ranking del valor neto, apostar por la tecnología se considera una medida forzada. Aunque el ajuste de cartera hacia la IA y los semiconductores ha logrado una recuperación temporal del rendimiento, también los ha colocado en medio de la controversia sobre el "desvío de estilo".

excerpt_i18n.en: On May 18, Baidu released its Q1 2026 financial report, showing total quarterly revenue of 32.1 billion yuan. Baidu's core business revenue reached 26 billion yuan, up 2% year-over-year, exceeding market expectations. AI business revenue accounted for 13.6 billion yuan, representing 52% of Baidu's core business revenue and growing for multiple consecutive quarters. "In Q1, AI business revenue exceeded half of Baidu's core business revenue for the first time, indicating that AI has become Baidu's core growth driver," said Baidu founder Robin Li. "Driven by surging enterprise demand and our differentiated full-stack AI capabilities built over years, AI cloud revenue has shown strong growth momentum. Baidu's AI applications continue to expand their influence among enterprises and individuals, further validating the commercial potential of Baidu's AI innovations. Meanwhile, Apollo Go has maintained triple-digit growth in fully driverless ride-hailing trips and continues to advance international expansion. We believe AI will bring greater value to Baidu in the coming quarters." Full-stack AI capabilities stand out, AI cloud grows 79% rapidly. During the quarter, Baidu AI cloud revenue reached 8.8 billion yuan, up 79% year-over-year; GPU cloud revenue grew 184% year-over-year. Baidu Intelligent Cloud has been fully upgraded to a new full-stack AI cloud for large-scale intelligent agent applications, with comprehensive evolution of Agent Infra and AI Infra capabilities, further strengthening end-to-end collaboration from underlying computing power to intelligent agent applications, providing a solid foundation for intelligent agent development. In terms of computing hardware, Kunlun Core P800 has completed large-scale validation, delivering multiple 10,000-card clusters.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 18 de mayo, Baidu publicó los resultados financieros del primer trimestre de 2026, que muestran unos ingresos totales trimestrales de 32.100 millones de yuanes. De ellos, los ingresos del negocio de IA fueron de 13.600 millones de yuanes, lo que representa el 52% de los ingresos del negocio general de Baidu, y han crecido durante varios trimestres consecutivos. "En el primer trimestre, los ingresos del negocio de IA de Baidu superaron por primera vez la mitad de los ingresos del negocio general, lo que indica que la IA se ha convertido en el motor central de Baidu", afirmó Robin Li, fundador de Baidu. "Impulsados por el aumento de la demanda empresarial y las capacidades diferenciadas de IA de pila completa que hemos desarrollado durante años, los ingresos de la nube de IA han mostrado un fuerte impulso de crecimiento. Las aplicaciones de IA de Baidu continúan en el ámbito empresarial".

On May 18, 2026, Shanghai — The evolution curve of AGI in the physical world is being redefined by China's top engineering teams. Today, Matrix Super Intelligence, a hardcore benchmark in the embodied intelligence field, grandly hosted the "2026 Matrix Super Intelligence Technology Day (AI DAY)" at the Zhangjiang Integrated Innovation Park in Shanghai. This is not just a technology showcase but a powerful breakthrough by domestic embodied intelligence toward global top-tier standards. Led by Zhang Haixing, former founding leader of Tesla China Design and Research Center, the "engineering dream team" deeply understands the underlying logic of transitioning from laboratories to large-scale industrialization. The team does not blindly pursue single metrics but adheres to first principles. Through systematic reconstruction of core joints, the dexterous hand MATRIX HAND, and the generalized brain, they have created a "Chinese Optimus" that can truly work and compete globally. On-site, the MATRIX-3 all-purpose flagship humanoid robot stunned the audience with its impressive real-world operations, declaring the perfect integration of its "digital brain" and "strong body."  

Technical Breakthrough: Deep Integration of Generalized Brain and Strong Body  
In product iteration and technological breakthroughs, any grand vision requires down-to-earth progress. From the first-generation engineering validation machine proving the feasibility of full direct-drive joints and demonstrating China's independent robot development capabilities to the world, to the newly released MATRIX-3, the series has undergone a significant leap in size and design philosophy. The newly unveiled MATRIX-3 stands 170 cm tall and weighs 65 kg, designed to closely match human proportions.

No se trata solo de una exhibición tecnológica, sino de un poderoso avance de la inteligencia encarnada nacional hacia los estándares globales de primer nivel. Liderado por Zhang Haixing, exdirector fundador del Centro de Diseño e Investigación de Tesla China, el "Equipo de Ensueño de Ingeniería" comprende a fondo la lógica subyacente de pasar del laboratorio a la industrialización a gran escala. El equipo no persigue ciegamente indicadores únicos, sino que se adhiere a los principios fundamentales, insistiendo en los núcleos clave.
